notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.6.6: review you can trust

• Review path: a Work Item ready for review leads you through Preview, then Evidence, then your decision. What you have reviewed belongs to that revision: after you request changes, the new revision starts the review again, and the earlier evidence is marked out of date while the new run works.
• Honest outcomes: a run that changed nothing says so, never "ready for your review", and offers Run again or Tell the Coordinator what to change. A stopped Work Item says where it really stopped, and stopped items now appear in the Inbox.
• The Coordinator reads your messages on the Work Item's own agent, so a change request on a stopped item starts the next attempt with your message.
• Board counts filter the list, and your filters and view are kept when you come back. A Work Item reopens where you left it.
• Local models: models are sized to this Mac's memory, an installed model that is too large says so, the model's memory is freed as soon as a run ends, and Python and Node projects get a smaller VM on a local model.
• Fixed: Copy as Markdown on a Proof Pack; plain Python projects are recognised as Python.
